name: What kind of renovations add the most value to a rental property?

mainEntity.name: What kind of renovations add the most value to a rental property?

acceptedAnswer.text: When renovating a rental property, focus on updates that enhance durability, reduce maintenance, and appeal to a broad range of tenants. Kitchen and bathroom updates often yield the highest return on investment. Consider features like updated appliances, durable flooring (e.g., LVT or tile), fresh paint, and modern fixtures. Improving energy efficiency with new windows or updated insulation can also attract tenants and reduce utility costs, making your property more competitive in the Bay Area rental market.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen and bathroom updates, along with durable finishes and energy-efficient improvements, typically add the most value to rental properties.
